summary: Smith & Nephew plc, the UK-listed orthopedic group, filed a 6-K announcing that it issued a notice of redemption for the entire $350,000,000 outstanding principal of its 5.150% Notes due 2027 (CUSIP 83192PAC2), governed by its October 14, 2020 indenture. The notes will be redeemed on October 5, 2026 at a redemption price calculated per the indenture, with The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch, acting as trustee and paying agent. NYSE listing cancels on or shortly after the redemption date. No board recommendation or financial advisor disclosed. Watch the make-whole economics and any refinancing signals.
